content.short: Metaradar.io helps you track multiple blockchain addresses and receive real-time email notifications.
content.description: Managing a large set of blockchain addresses can quickly become overwhelming. Metaradar.io makes it easy to monitor all your addresses in one place and stay ahead of activity. You’ll receive proactive email alerts for any on-chain transactions or wallet signatures, so you can respond promptly without checking each address individually. Whether you’re tracking portfolios, contributors, or project wallets, Metaradar.io helps you maintain a clear, up-to-date picture of activity and risk.

resources.title: Alerts on Addresses You Do Not Own
resources.tldr: Watch any address across chains and get an email the moment it transacts or signs. Useful for treasuries and for suspicion.

resources.title: Monitoring Many Wallets at Once
resources.tldr: The problem it solves: past a handful of addresses, nobody checks an explorer often enough to catch anything.
